author: KEXP
description: Under the musical project Chanpan, Grace Dumdaw and identical twins Lance and Matthew Tran create at the intersection of dance pop, DnB, and jazz. With host Diana Ratsamee, the trio share a performance of "buzzin" and more.
title: Chanpan performs "buzzin" & more Live on KEXP
